name: Punishment For Adultery
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a grievous sin, commanding in Exodus 20:14, 'Thou shalt not commit adultery.' The Old Testament prescribes the death penalty for both the adulterer and adulteress to remove evil from the community (Leviticus 20:10; Deuteronomy 22:22). Proverbs 6:32 highlights the destructive nature of adultery, stating it destroys the soul, while Jesus in Matthew 5:28 deepens the understanding by teaching that even lustful intent is adultery in the heart. Additionally, Matthew 19:9 emphasizes the sanctity of marriage by declaring remarriage after divorce, except for fornication, as adultery.
